London Police Officer of Indian Origin Charged with Sexual Assault

A detective sergeant of Indian origin in London has been charged with five counts of sexual assault. The charges involve four women known to the officer. He was arrested in April and subsequently suspended from his position. The Crown Prosecution Service authorized the charges following an investigation. The officer's name is Prakash Patel.
